Covered the ground instead with native-detector agreement (True) plus selftest 33/33 plus evolve smoke. The brief needs an amendment mapping #3 to a real command.

title: BUILD doc evolve command missing required --evidence flag
body: The doc's evolve invocation omits --evidence, which the CLI requires, and the r9 evolution output file is not valid evidence input (load_evidence needs a judge artifact with rows). Used ARC/cain/arena_llm_judgments_r9.json instead; smoke passed with q=0.7506. Same brief-amendment bucket as 316t-001.

title: Suite counts in BUILD doc are stale (24 selftest, 11 pytest) vs live (33, 51)
body: Both acceptance counts moved since 2026-11-05: selftest printed 33 checks and pytest collected 51 tests, all passing on 3.16t. Stale numbers in a gate read as failure when an executor diffs text; gates should assert zero-failed, not exact totals.

title: WALKAROUND-FIRST doctrine: walk around walls, never push them, on any OS
body: User affirmed the Cloudflare bypass-kit assessment (walk around the wall instead of pushing it) and ordered the same bypass-engineering for Windows elevated-ADMIN/home-OS restrictions, evolving for ANY OS/environment by default. Codified as walkaround_first in adopt-recipes.json with five session precedents: MKL vendored INTO the wheel instead of system32/admin install (clean-env spsolve with zero app-dir DLLs), app-local interpreter+venv, neutral-cwd difftest, forge-dressing over package-patching. Per-OS walkarounds live as DATA rows in recipes, never code forks. No elevation, no system dirs, no registry — restrictions are routing information, not blockers.

title: Post-analysis decision blocks: MORPH/MUTATE/TRANSMOGRIFY/TRANSSUBSTANTIATE options always provided
body: User requirement: after analyzation of code base, the foundry must give suggested followups plus clickable decision blocks, with options to MORPH, MUTATE, TRANSMOGRIFY, TRANSSUBSTANTIATE always provided for hyper-edge dev manifest destiny. Implementation: oxenford-proffer.py gains a decisions section — every analysis verdict is followed by structured decision blocks, one per transformation verb, each naming the target, the change shape, and its proof command. In chat surfaces these map to clickable followups; on disk they persist as JSON in state/ so any later session can execute them without re-deriving.

title: Corporate in-house native: full-suite admin, every paid task native here
body: User mandate: the foundry must natively support corporations in-house with full-suite admin — basically everything done corporately and any task someone is paid to do is native here. Implementation: oxenford-install.py gains corporate flags (--unattended silent deploy, --licensee/--accept-soulforge license acceptance, --record deployment-manifest JSON with wheel hashes + probe results for audit), building on walkaround-first (no elevation, works on locked-down corporate images) and the offline wheelhouse (air-gap installs). Doctrine recorded as corporate_native in adopt-recipes.json.

title: shutil.which lies: harness now resolves absolute tool paths
body: shutil.which found nmake on the captured vsenv Path, yet subprocess CreateProcess raised FileNotFoundError under the same env. Root cause class: PATH-resolution inside a foreign env block is unreliable. Harness evolution: nasm-build.py resolves the absolute tool path by filesystem glob (OXENFORD_NMAKE) and smoke-spawns nmake /? before building; resolution-by-search is gone from the build path.

title: Inline heredocs mangle Windows paths: debug via written files only
body: Three consecutive inline python heredocs corrupted backslashes (nasmlib file.c path collapsed), each costing a full diagnostic round-trip. Harness rule recorded: any debugging that carries Windows paths uses scripts written via the file tool, never inline heredocs. Symptom of violation is a path that looks right in the command but wrong in the error.

title: Merge drops become write-time rejects: tools/bake_append.py
body: merge_bake_lane dropped 3 forge rows as BAD_KIND (fact is not in its KINDS set); evidence nearly lost at merge time. Harness evolution: tools/bake_append.py is now the sanctioned lane writer - it rejects bad kinds and short bodies at write time (proven: accepts good, rejects fact kind, rejects 4-char body) so the merge can stay strict and lossless.

title: Every error ships a harness mechanism, not just a fix
body: User mandate: all errors made must evolve the agentic harness. Standing rule: an error row is incomplete until it names the code, check, or doctrine that makes that error class impossible or self-diagnosing next time. Fixes without mechanisms are rework scheduled for later. Recorded 2026-11-06 with three shipped mechanisms: absolute-path tool resolution, write-time lane validation, file-based Windows debugging.

title: landing kind: accomplishment rows carry artifact+sha+verify
body: Three forge rows hid under kind fact and nearly died as BAD_KIND drops. Merge and writer now enforce a landing kind requiring artifact, sha and verify fields; the three rows were reclassified with their proof intact. A landing without its proof is a claim, not evidence.

title: evidence fields: recollection warning on fixes without proof
body: bake_append accepts optional evidence_cmd, exit_code and digest, persisted through the merge. Fixes and lessons filed without evidence print a recollection warning instead of failing, so field crews never lose a row to a missing digest while the nudge toward proof stays visible.

title: oxenford_spawn: resolve-absolute plus smoke, shared by all engines
body: shutil.which found nmake yet CreateProcess failed under the captured vsenv. New shared helper resolves absolute tool paths by filesystem glob, smoke-spawns before use (rc -1 means absent, never retry), and normalizes foreign envs to one spelling per key. nasm-build is wired to it; adopt and forge follow.
digest: resolve OK, smoke OK, absent rc=-1, normalize OK

title: gate recognizes dated state snapshots as generated
body: The corporate commit tripped the per-file line cap on regenerated proffer and wheelhouse-manifest JSONs. commit_gate now classifies state/<name>-YYYY-MM-DD.json as generated, consistent with its philosophy that bytes no human wrote are exempt while source rows are judged as if generated rows were absent. Narrow on purpose: bare state JSONs stay judged.

title: adopt and forge prove themselves with --self-test
body: Both engines gained runnable self-tests with no network and no builds: adopt checks recipe schema, probe compilability, diagnose mappings, closure and plan; forge checks maker dispatch, sha determinism and bundle-plus-manifest on a temp dir. Forge land() now writes landing rows with artifact, sha and verify instead of kind fact.

title: diagnose_include_chain technique recorded while warm
body: nasm C1189 root-caused by chain tracing: single-TU showIncludes, minimal-flag bisection with a 2-line header probe, and reading the SDK guard itself (winnt checks _AMD64_, not _M_X64) before theorizing. Recorded in adopt-recipes.json as diagnose_include_chain so the next header failure starts from the technique, not from zero.

title: superseded_by retires rows without deleting history
body: Lane rows now carry an optional superseded_by pointer to the newer row that retires them. The merge persists it, counts SUPERSEDED separately, and keeps history in the merged set so consumers can tell settled rows apart without losing archaeology. Nothing marked yet; mechanism precedes judgment.

title: Default at startup: agent test prescribes harness corrections
body: User mandate: the default at startup shall be an agent test determining corrective adjustments so the harness is driven correctly. tools/harness_startup.py runs five checks (interpreters, imports, recipes live==snapshot, engine self-tests, lossless merge dry-run), each printing the exact corrective command, exit 1 naming corrections top-down. First run: 5 PASS, proceed.
